opportunities.title: 2027 Nuffield Farming Scholarships

deadlines.raw: Application deadline is at Midday on Thursday 30th July 2026.

next_open_date.raw: Applications for the 2027 Nuffield Farming Scholarships are now open.

amount.raw: A bursary of £9,000 will be given towards the Scholars study tour and subsistence expenses.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligibility requirements can be found on the Essential Information page.
opportunities.summary: Nuffield Farming Scholarships are an amazing opportunity that can benefit careers, industry and business, as well as advancing personal development. We award approximately 25 individuals each year with the opportunity to research topics of interest in either farming, food, horticulture, forestry or any other countryside and ancillary industry.

opportunities.title: 2027 Next-Gen Nuffield Scholarships

deadlines.raw: The deadline for applications is the 31st January 2027.

next_open_date.raw: Applications for the 2027 Next-Gen Scholarship will open in November 2026.

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be aged 18-24 and have a demonstrable interest in the dairy industry or regenerative agriculture.
opportunities.summary: The Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship is aimed at young people aged 18-24 as part of our initiative to develop young talent. We know the challenges that young people face to establish themselves in our industry, and this scholarship will use the Nuffield Scholar network to link successful applicants directly to farmers.
